title: Treasury Intervention Counters Hawkish Fed: Order Flow Triggers Gold Breakout
excerpt: Despite hawkish FOMC minutes signaling potential further rate hikes, aggressive Treasury bond buybacks have capsized long-end yields and crushed the US Dollar to three-month lows. Smart Money order flow reveals textbook Wyckoff Phase C liquidity sweeps across FX majors and a massive VSA effort-versus-result breakout in Spot Gold.
